per_stage.story-plan: Architect, Mode STORY-PLAN. Reads the item file and the cli code at the item's base. Writes OUTER/.cleargate/sprint-runs/SPRINT-47/plans/<ID>.md (at most 150 lines) and the item's Task Breakdown rows in OUTER/.cleargate/delivery/pending-sync, before the cli worktree is cut.
per_stage.qa-red: QA, Mode RED, working only in OUTER/.worktrees/<ID>/cleargate-cli. It writes the failing tests, plus any earlier-sprint sealed red edits named in the item's note, in the same commit. Last step: ORCHESTRATOR_PROJECT_DIR=OUTER bash OUTER/.cleargate/scripts/run_script.sh seal_red.mjs <ID> --worktree OUTER/.worktrees/<ID>/cleargate-cli --sprint-branch <stories.<ID>.base> -- <files>. Verified against the live script: its git steps run with git -C <worktree> in the cli repo, where the base branch exists. Its records go to OUTER's sprint dir (ROOT = sprintRoot of the live scripts dir), and it finds the item in OUTER's delivery tree. The scan records typecheck as N/A, because the configured 'npm --prefix cleargate-cli' target is not inside the cli worktree. The scan resolves no story id from the base branch, so no lane routing runs, and its report lands under the cli's gitignored /.cleargate/. The build lane therefore runs npm run typecheck itself.
per_stage.architect-tpv: Architect, Mode TPV, dispatched only when the seal line has scan_exit != 0 (2 included) or a non-empty flags list (non-removable safeguard).
per_stage.developer: Developer in the cli worktree. One commit: feat(EPIC-065): STORY-065-NN <desc>. Runs npm run typecheck and targeted tests (npm run test:file -- <file>) only. It never edits a sealed red; the cli repo has no hooks, so this is enforced by role and by QA-Verify's diff review.
per_stage.qa-verify: QA, Mode VERIFY. First step: live prep_qa_context.mjs <ID> OUTER/.worktrees/<ID>/cleargate-cli. Its commands block is outer-relative, so QA runs the cli equivalents in the cli worktree. It runs the item's sprint-plan Proof column check (rule 1) and reports PROOF and DEFECT_IN as the live qa.md says.
per_stage.architect-review: Architect, Mode POST-FLIGHT. Always for runtime items; for standard items only on a flagged seal.
per_stage.merge: The merge lane (see merge_lane). Not merge_story.mjs.

execution.tests: Build lanes run npm run typecheck and targeted test files only. The full npm test and npm run test:integration run only in the merge lane, in a throwaway cli worktree at main's tip. Never run two full suites at once (fixed ports). Run full suites with a short private TMPDIR. A throwaway cli worktree has no dist, so build dist there before running tests that spawn dist.
execution.integration: An item integrates only after every upstream item has merged into cli main. In its cli worktree: git merge --no-ff main. On a conflict in a shared source file the owner's region wins and the item re-applies its own insertions. A conflict inside an existing or red test goes to QA-Red, never to the Developer. Never hand-merge a generated file: run npm run gen:codex, then confirm prebuild's build-codex-payload.mjs --check passes (npm run gen:codex -- --check ignores --check; flashcard 2026-11-10 #codegen #gen-codex). Then re-run prebuild, typecheck and the item's targeted tests, then QA-Verify on the integrated tree. If main moves before the merge, integrate again. Re-integration proof: diff main..HEAD over scaffold/, src/ and scripts/ equals the item's own delta, minus regenerated files (flashcard 2026-09-26 #integration #contract).
execution.merge_lane: One item at a time, by a DevOps dispatch: in the cli main checkout, git merge --no-ff story/<ID> (local only; no push, no publish). Then run the full npm test and npm run test:integration in a throwaway cli worktree at main's tip, and judge failures against the kickoff baseline list and known_red_after_merge. Teardown, with both git status --porcelain empty: remove the cli worktree first, then the outer host, then delete story/<ID>. Then the orchestrator runs update_state.mjs <ID> Done (proof_per_item). Record this route in sprint section 6 as the layout's edge case, against the skill's 'merge_story.mjs is the one route' line.
execution.merge_order_rule: The merge lane takes items as they pass QA-Verify, subject to upstream (stories.<ID>.upstream is authoritative; waves[] is a view). In layer 0, when items are ready together: 02 first (it unblocks 03, 04 and 06), then 01 (it unblocks 04 and 06), then 05. In layer 1, on a tie 04 goes before 03 (04 unblocks 06). 06 merges last. Swapping the merge order of two items with no upstream between them makes the later one re-integrate main and re-run QA-Verify (flashcard 2026-11-10 #merge #contract); preview with git merge-tree.
execution.codex_generated_companions: Every generated file has one source and is regenerated, never hand-edited (scripts/build-codex-payload.mjs). core/.agents/skills/sprint-execution/SKILL.md is rendered from hosts/claude/.claude/skills/sprint-execution/SKILL.md. It has three editors, 01, 04 and 06, serialized by the edges 01 -> 04 -> 06; each regenerates it in its own commit and again at integration. core/.agents/skills/sprint-execution/dispatch-serial.md is a byte copy of the Claude file; 04 is its only editor. frozen_exports: cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: ESM with no top-level side effects; imports only node:fs, node:path and ./work-item-id.mjs.
cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export const PROOF_TIERS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(['unit', 'container', 'live', 'human']), in this order.

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function isProofTier(x: unknown): boolean. True only for a string exactly equal to a PROOF_TIERS entry (no trimming, no case folding).

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function parseProofCommand(content: string): string | null. The body of prep_qa_context.mjs:545-567 verbatim: the first non-blank line, trimmed, of the first fenced block under a '## Proof' heading, which is recognised only outside fences. Plus one rule (open decision 4): a line that is a whole {...} placeholder (/^\{.*\}$/ after trim) returns null.

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function readProofTier(content: string): string | null. The proof_tier value of the leading '---' frontmatter block, trimmed, with one level of surrounding quotes removed and a trailing ' # comment' dropped. null when the block or key is absent or the value is empty. It does not validate (isProofTier does), so a declared but invalid tier is non-null and the Done guard fails closed on it.

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function findItemFile(repoRoot: string, id: string): string | null. The body of init_sprint.mjs:117-130 verbatim: pending-sync, then archive; directory names sorted; matchesId from ./work-item-id.mjs.
cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function evidencePath(sprintDir: string, id: string): string = path.join(sprintDir, 'evidence', id + '.json').

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function readEvidence(sprintDir: string, id: string): Evidence | null. The parsed object, or null when the file is missing, unreadable, not JSON, not an object, or its status is not 'pass' | 'fail' | 'pending'. Synchronous; never throws.

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/lib/proof.mjs: export function proofStatus(evidence: Evidence | null, tier: string): { ok: boolean, reason: 'missing' | 'pending' | 'fail' | 'tier' | null, recorded_tier: string | null }. Pure. Precedence: null evidence -> 'missing'; status 'pending' -> 'pending'; status 'fail' -> 'fail'; evidence.tier !== tier -> 'tier'; otherwise ok true and reason null. recorded_tier = evidence?.tier ?? null. STORY-065-03 renders 'tier' as 'tier <recorded_tier>'.

File <sprintDir>/evidence/<ID>.json (Evidence), written only by record_evidence.mjs, atomically (tmp + rename): { schema_version: 1, id: string, tier: 'unit'|'container'|'live'|'human', status: 'pass'|'fail'|'pending', mode: 'command'|'human'|'pending', command: string|null, note: string|null, exit_code: number|null, timed_out: boolean, excused: 'baseline'|null, excused_failing: string[], tail: string[] (at most 40 lines, env secrets masked as ***), sha: string|null, recorded_at: string (ISO-8601), recorded_by: 'record_evidence.mjs', duration_ms: number }. Every key is present. command is a string only in mode 'command' and note only in mode 'human'; exit_code is null unless mode is 'command'; excused_failing is [] unless excused (open decision 3). Readers treat an absent key as null or [].

cleargate-cli/scaffold/core/.cleargate/scripts/record_evidence.mjs: CLI `node record_evidence.mjs <ID> [--tier <t>] [--worktree <dir>] [-- <command...>]` or `node record_evidence.mjs <ID> --human "<note>"`. Exit 0 = pass or pending (evidence written; stdout is one JSON line, the file's object). Exit 1 = proof failed (evidence written; one JSON line). Exit 2 = could not run: nothing written, nothing on stdout, one stderr line starting 'record_evidence: ' that names the reason (e.g. 'no proof tier for <ID>', 'no <tier> proof command configured'). Env: CLEARGATE_PROOF_TIMEOUT_S (default 1800), CLEARGATE_SPRINT_DIR (test override). main() sits behind an entry-point guard, so importing the module runs nothing.

C1 stub of record_evidence.mjs: prints 'record_evidence: contract C1 stub (STORY-065-02 not integrated)' on stderr, exits 2 and writes nothing. Exit 2 is fail-safe: the barrier halts rather than merging.

pinned_interfaces.note: Cross-story interfaces that need no branch: they are text formats, rules or prompt text. The consumer builds against the pin; its end-to-end check goes green on the integrated tree.
pinned_interfaces.P1: '## Proof' section (owner STORY-065-01's templates; readers STORY-065-02's parseProofCommand and STORY-065-01's proof-declared). The heading is exactly '## Proof' (/^##\s+Proof\s*$/), recognised outside fences, placed directly after the acceptance/verification section. Bullets: '- **Tier:**', '- **Expected result:**', '- **Why human:**', '- **Steps:**'. The command is the first non-blank line of the first fenced block under the heading; the section ends at the next '#' or '##' heading. A {...} placeholder is empty in both readers: the predicate treats it as missing, and parseProofCommand returns null (open decision 4). A fenced block in the template holds only a {...} placeholder.
pinned_interfaces.P2: Holdout rule (owner STORY-065-05's parser, exported from qa_red_lint.mjs; mirrored in TypeScript by STORY-065-01's proof-declared, with no import across src/ and scaffold/). It applies only inside fenced gherkin blocks. A scenario is a holdout when the single line directly above its 'Scenario:' or 'Scenario Outline:' line is a tag line (only @word tokens) containing '@holdout'. The withheld extent runs from that tag line to the line before the next tag line, Scenario or Scenario Outline line, or the fence end; an outline's Examples go with it. Both stories' tests include '@paths @holdout' (among other tags) and '@holdout' on its own.
pinned_interfaces.P3: prove stage (owner STORY-065-04). STAGE_NAMES gains 'prove' directly before 'merge'; its def is { name: 'prove', kind: 'barrier-script', when: 'always', script: 'record_evidence.mjs' }; every lane's list ends 'prove', 'merge'. wave_runner.js stops at the first barrier-script, so stages_run never contains prove or merge. The SKILL section 5 paths table and a 'stage `prove`' note in section C carry it (loop-spec-three-paths.red T1 checks both renderings).
pinned_interfaces.P4: Done choice at merge (owner STORY-065-03; consumer STORY-065-04's section C.7 text, which replaces 'marks the item `Done`'). merge_story.mjs's state step moves an item to Done when its evidence passes at its declared tier. It moves it to 'Sprint Review' when the item declares a tier and the evidence is missing, pending, fail or another tier; the tail then reads 'awaiting proof: <tier> (<reason>)'. It moves it to Done when the item declares no tier (open decision 5). The JSON result gains state: 'Done' | 'Sprint Review' and evidence: <path> | null. update_state.mjs <ID> Done exits 1 with 'Error: <ID> has no <tier>-tier evidence (<path>: missing|pending|fail|tier <recorded>)' and appends nothing.
pinned_interfaces.P5: Sprint Review at the walkthrough and at close (owners STORY-065-04 section D and STORY-065-06). The walkthrough starts when every item is Done or in Sprint Review. Close Step 2 accepts Sprint Review. An item with no proof_tier is reported '<ID>: no proof tier declared (not guarded)' and is not unproven. An item that declares deferred_verification and has neither a green deferred-verify result nor an evidence file keeps CR-082's Step 2.9 failure output for one release (open decision 6).
